mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.model_type, s.status, s.message_count, s.last_message, s.created_at, s.updated_at, ( SELECT content FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = s.id AND role = 'user' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS title FROM chat_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.model_type, s.status, s.message_count, s.last_message, s.created_at, s.updated_at, ( SELECT content FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = s.id AND role = 'user' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS title FROM chat_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
